raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
raw.description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.
  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.
  • You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.
  • You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.
  • You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.
  • Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.
  • Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.

Why join us

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.

Tensordyne Values

  • Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.
  • Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.
  • Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.
  • Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.
  • Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

title: IT Manager (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena, finanziert von Google Ventures, macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie digital weiter. Mit jeder Übernahme wachsen auch unsere Anforderungen an die IT: Neue Mitarbeitende, Geräte und Standorte sollen zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere IT übernimmt und mit unserem Wachstum weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln. Was du bei uns machst Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk. Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um. Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware. Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung. Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können. Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen. Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune. Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi. Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären. Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss. Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen. Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch. Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was du bei uns bekommst Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest. Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege. Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus. MacBook und Studio Display. 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest. Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro. Dabei interessiert uns, wie du Probleme eingrenzt, Prioritäten setzt und deine Überlegungen erklärst. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations
description: Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung! Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben: Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung. Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme. Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher. Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern. Finance Transformation & Standardisierung Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg. Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter. Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe. Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften. Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte. Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus. Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert. Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre. Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus. Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit. Unser Bewerbungsprozess:   Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.   Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! title: Communications Lead
description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role We publish a lot of original evidence about AI search: a quarterly industry report, a public Index, and findings from our own research team. Right now each piece reaches the market on its own, and nobody owns the story that connects them. We're hiring a Communications Lead to own that story. You'll decide the few ideas Peec should be known for, write and edit the work that carries them, and keep them consistent across research, founder comms, press, events, social and campaigns. This is a senior individual contributor role based in Berlin. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with our founders, our product marketer, and our research and content team. What you'll do Decide what Peec is known for. Pick the two or three ideas we want to own, the evidence behind each, and how the story develops quarter to quarter. Write it down so the rest of the company can repeat it. Turn research into stories. Work with the research team to find what in the data our audience will care about most, then carry it out: the report intro, the founder post, the journalist brief, the stage premise. Same evidence, told differently for each audience. Shape our social strategy. You set what Peec and our founders talk about on social and how each story runs across LinkedIn and our other channels. The social and content team runs the channels day to day. Work with product marketing so launches and the brand story say the same thing. Write and edit the highest-stakes work yourself. Founder and expert pieces, press materials, campaign copy and research comms. Brief writers and producers on the rest, and hold every contributor to the same bar. Run founder and expert communications. Talking points, interview prep, opinion pieces, stage remarks and founder posts on LinkedIn, with honest feedback afterwards. Make our founders and experts consistently good on the record. Lead press and publisher strategy. Bring the news judgment, angles and briefing materials, and pitch journalists yourself. Treat independent coverage and sponsored placements differently. Make Peec citable in AI search. We help marketing teams see and improve how AI search talks about them. Our own story should be the best-cited example in the category, and you own how ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini describe Peec. What we're looking for You've led an integrated launch at a B2B tech company, taking original research or a complex product to a clear story shipped across channels. You can walk us from raw evidence to final assets: what you wrote, what you commissioned, where the story changed and what you refused to claim. You write fast, in many formats, and in someone else's voice when needed. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear. You are comfortable with data. As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d), you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. You work daily with the safety (software) engineers and with TÜV to define what must be verified. Early on, you set up and prove the verification system for the current system, and you then carry it into the certification of the new controller.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the verification of our new safety controller end to end, from the verification plan to the certification evidence (target PL d per ISO 13849-1:2023 and SIL 2 per IEC 61508)

  • Build the complete verification catalog and set up the verification process and structure from scratch

  • Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

  • Automate verification so that it runs on every change

  • Verify the controller and its safety functions as part of the robot arm against ISO 10218-1:2025

  • Keep traceability from risk assessment to test results and write reports that hold up in an audit

  • Work closely with the safety (software) engineers and TÜV to define what must be verified

  • Review the verification work of your colleagues and share your practices with the team

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A degree in a technical field such as software, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of experience verifying or testing safety-critical embedded systems in industrial automation, automotive, rail, aerospace or medical devices

  • Enough embedded C to write white-box tests and to find defects in a code review

  • Working knowledge of IEC 61508-3 or its industry counterpart (ISO 26262-6, EN 50716, DO-178C) and the verification evidence it requires

  • Hands-on lab skills with oscilloscope, logic analyser and debugger, including measuring a reaction time you can defend

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with EtherCAT and Safety over EtherCAT (FSoE) or another safety protocol such as PROFIsafe or CIP Safety is a plus

    • Experience with ISO 10218-1:2025, ISO 13849-1:2023 or IEC 62061, HIL tooling, coverage and static analysis tools (e.g. VectorCAST, TESSY, LDRA, Polyspace), MISRA C, robot kinematics, or working with a certification body such as TÜV is a plus

    • Clear technical writing and fluent English (C1+); German is a plus

title: Director of Procurement & Trading
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. The Role This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading : fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly. You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space. raw.title: Director of Procurement & Trading
raw.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Role

This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading: fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly.

You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space.

You report directly to the C level and sit on the commercial and operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement.

The core purpose of this role is to build one buying strategy that combines three things:

  • Spot trading, run as a repeatable system with a regular market-coverage schedule and clear KPIs;

  • Strategic buying, where you negotiate allocations, framework agreements and terms with Tier-1 manufacturers and develop private-label and direct-from-factory categories;

  • Supply planning, where you set the mix of spot, contract and stock and keep price and inventory risk under control.

Each part on its own is not enough. The job is to make them work together so that Andercore buys at the right price, secures supply when the market tightens, and never holds stock it cannot sell.

What You Will Do

  • Build and run the procurement machine: Develop and execute procurement strategies that support an 8-digit monthly procurement spend with exponential growth. Negotiate favourable terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers on a daily basis.

  • Lead and develop the team: Manage 10+ team members, set clear priorities daily, coach emerging team leads, and create a culture of accountability and speed. You will need to be assertive and hands-on. Be the player-coach. Close deals yourself and hire the people you need to scale

  • Create scalable processes: Design, implement, and continuously improve procurement workflows, playbooks, and controls. Processes are implemented in days and weeks at Andercore — not quarters and years.

  • Own supplier relationships: Source, evaluate, and onboard suppliers. Maintain and expand a high-quality supplier network with strong retention across existing and emerging markets.

  • Drive margin improvement: Identify cost-saving opportunities, optimise purchasing decisions, and improve payment terms to boost net revenue margin and cash cycle.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Accounting, and Product & Engineering to align supply with demand and ensure operational excellence.

  • Full P&L responsibility: for the supply side.

  • Leverage data and AI: Use data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor supplier performance, and identify market trends. Embrace AI tools to automate and scale procurement operations.

  • AI-native procurement: automate processes from RFQs through to order confirmations, with sellers as co-designers of the agents.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue and margin targets consistently met or exceeded through high availability and competitive pricing.

  • A robust, high-quality supplier network with strong retention and engagement across existing and emerging markets.

  • Streamlined, repeatable processes that reduce time-to-onboard, minimise errors, and allow the team to scale without linear headcount growth.

  • A high-performing, motivated team with emerging team leads and strong cross-functional collaboration.

  • Accurate, data-driven reporting that drives continuous improvement and informs executive strategy.

  • Run a category management that unlocks and owns new product lines

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top university or business school.

  • 4+ years in a high-performance environment: for example commodity trading / high-velocity B2B procurement.

  • Proven ability to build processes and delegate effectively. You must be able to create systems that outlast your personal involvement — not do everything yourself.

  • Strong assertiveness and people leadership. You will manage a young team that needs clear direction, daily prioritisation, and coaching.

  • Ability to operate at both strategic and granular levels: setting category strategy in the morning and reviewing individual POs in the afternoon.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with a high-intensity, fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift daily.

  • Proven results negotiating from the smaller side of the table, i.e. securing allocation, pricing and terms when you are not the biggest customer.

  • Hard-working, proactive, and independent. Willing to go the extra mile to get the job done.

  • A personal track record in spot or commodity trading with margin ownership.

  • Experience scaling a team, plus forecasting and inventory risk management.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, or construction / infrastructure / energy materials.

  • Exposure to AI-driven operations or automation of procurement workflows.

  • Familiarity with cross-border trade and international supplier management.

  • Tier-1 strategy consulting background (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain).

This Role Is Not For You If…

  • Your procurement experience is in slow-cycle, enterprise purchasing (annual contracts, quarterly reviews). Our cadence is daily.

  • You are strong on analysis but weak on implementation. We need someone who executes, not just diagnoses.

  • You prefer to do things yourself rather than build teams and processes. Delegation and system-building are non-negotiable.

  • You need a fully structured environment to be effective. Here, you will create the structure.

What We Offer

  • A critical leadership role with direct impact on company growth and P&L.

  • Highly competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

  • A smart, ambitious team backed by top-tier investors — building something that doesn’t exist yet.

  • Berlin headquarters with a global, multicultural operating environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description: Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. raw.title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
raw.description:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools they use, you'll turn what each review teaches us into shared components, conventions, tests and agent instructions. Over time the whole practice becomes more predictable, and each new branch arrives closer to production-ready.

Roles and collaboration

Software development roles are blurring more than ever. This role reports to product design, with API and data-layer guidance from our control plane engineering lead. You must be attuned to the perspectives of both UX/Design and Engineering, acting as a bridge between the goals and priorities of both sides, while ultimately deferring to UX/design partners on matters of style, copy, and information architecture.

In practice: when a designer's branch makes a choice about layout, copy or flow, you protect the intent and fix the implementation. When the implementation can't support the intent, because of performance, data shape or maintainability, you say so early and bring options rather than quietly changing the design.

What you'll do

  • Review designer-authored merge requests and bring them to production quality: structure, types, tests, accessibility, performance, and both light and dark themes.

  • Turn one-off UI from fast iteration into shared, documented components in our design system and Storybook, and migrate the apps onto them.

  • Make data-dense views hold up at real scale. Dashboards, tables, charts, and time-range and filter controls that work on a demo tenant also have to work on one with billions of events.

  • Wire UI to the API layer (GraphQL), and work with backend developers when a view needs a new query, field or endpoint.

  • Own UI test coverage: Vitest for units and Playwright for end-to-end flows, kept green in CI.

  • Test UI end to end in live, secured environments, with full authentication and authorization, real data and realistic load, before calling it done.

  • Keep UI work moving across release lines: shipping behind feature flags, and carrying fixes between branches when a release is frozen.

  • Fix UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac and Linux clients: layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing.

  • When needed, design new interfaces within the existing design system, and bring them to design for review.

  • Help set the guardrails that make AI-assisted UI development safe: lint rules, conventions, review checklists, and the instructions our AI coding tools follow.

How we expect you to work

These are the habits of a careful engineer. They matter more here, not less, because so much of the code you touch was drafted quickly by someone else or by an AI tool.

  1. Diagnose before you change. Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix.

  2. Small, deliberate diffs. Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later.

  3. Fix it in one place. When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill.

  4. Verify, then claim. Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, and write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it.

  5. Say when you're unsure. A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review.

Our UI stack and design system

Our front ends are several React and TypeScript apps that share one codebase: our enterprise operator consoles and our cloud product for builders.

All of them are built on our own design system. It is a shared React component library on top of Ant Design, with design tokens for color, type and spacing, light and dark themes, and a shared app shell for navigation, page layout and headers. Every component is documented in Storybook, published from CI, which serves as the reference for designers, engineers and AI coding tools alike. The library also carries written instructions for AI coding assistants, so generated code reaches for the system's components and tokens instead of inventing its own.

A large part of this role is the design system itself. That means promoting patterns out of individual apps into shared components, writing their stories, keeping tokens and themes consistent so the apps don't drift, and making the system the easiest path for anyone, or any agent, building UI.

  • Front end: React, TypeScript, Vite

  • Design system: our component library built on Ant Design, including design tokens and light and dark themes

  • Documentation: Storybook, published to GitLab Pages

  • Data and charts: GraphQL; ECharts for the data-dense views

  • Testing: Vitest, Playwright, and contract and smoke suites in CI

  • Delivery: GitLab merge requests and pipelines, release branches, feature flags

  • Further back: TypeScript and Rust services over graph and columnar stores, built on OpenTelemetry, plus desktop apps and services across Mac, Windows and Linux

You don't need experience with all of it. You do need to be strong in TypeScript and React, and willing to read code before changing it.

What you bring

  • About 3–5 years building production front ends in TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens.

  • An end-to-end view of the systems behind the UI. Designing in code gets a feature most of the way to working, and you close the rest of the gap. For you, “done” doesn’t stop at the UI working. It means the UI is integrated and shown to work live, in a secured environment with full authentication and authorization, under realistic load.

  • Integration testing against complex backends. Tests that only run against mock data in a standalone dev stack aren’t enough here. You can create, integrate and run tests in live environments to check data validity, load, security and scale, and you keep unit, integration and end-to-end suites green in CI.

  • Performance instincts for data-heavy UI: pagination, virtualization, server-side filtering, and knowing when a slow page is a query problem rather than a rendering problem.

  • A track record of reviewing other people’s code and improving it without rewriting it.

  • Git in complex repositories with several active release branches, where a single fix may need to be cherry-picked, ported or graft-merged onto more than one of them. Readable commits, and responding to review without taking it personally.

  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools in real work, with clear habits for checking what they produce.

  • CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, and why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped.

  • Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, ideally with Storybook and design tokens.

  • Careful attention to visual detail and real interest in UX. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing.

  • Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates.

Nice to have: Ant Design; GraphQL; ECharts or other charting libraries; design training or a portfolio; experience on a team where designers commit code; writing conventions or instructions for AI coding tools; desktop UI across Mac, Windows and Linux; dense operational tooling such as observability, security or infrastructure products.

Not required: a computer science degree, if your work shows the same rigor. Deep backend, security or infrastructure expertise, or any knowledge of our domain (fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement). We will teach that.

Your first 90 days

  1. First month: land changes safely. Ship scoped fixes in the consoles. Learn the component library, theme tokens and API layer. Start reviewing designer merge requests alongside an engineer.

  2. Second month: own review on a surface. Become the primary reviewer for designer-authored UI on one product area, and extract at least one repeated pattern into a shared component.

  3. Third month: make the next branch easier. Get the flows you own covered by tests in CI, and write down the conventions and guardrails that make designer branches need less hardening.

About BlueRock:

BlueRock is a well-funded, early stage cybersecurity company founded by experienced security minded entrepreneurs. Our mission is to change the game in cybersecurity. Attackers are exploiting in hours. The dependency tree is exploding. Developers are drowning in vulnerability debt. BlueRock changes the game, enabling organizations to shift from chasing CVEs and exploits to proactively protecting the foundations of applications and computing, so that developers can build great applications without looking over their shoulders.

Wir helfen ambitionierten E-Commerce-Brands dabei, durch strategisches E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Marketing nachhaltig zu wachsen. Retention-Strategie: Du entwickelst individuelle E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Strategien, um Umsatz, Wiederkaufraten und Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig zu steigern. Performance & Reporting: Du analysierst relevante KPIs, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und präsentierst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen in regelmäßigen Strategie- und Performance-Calls. Projekt- & Teamsteuerung: Du koordinierst unsere Copywriter, Designer und technischen Spezialisten und stellst sicher, dass Strategien effizient und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden. Kampagnen & Automationen: Du verantwortest die strategische Planung von Kampagnen, automatisierten Flows, Produktlaunches und saisonalen Aktionen. Kundenentwicklung & Retention: Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen und Abwanderungsrisiken, entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen langfristig aus. Das Besondere: Du bist nicht für das operative Tagesgeschäft verantwortlich. Dir steht ein spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam zur Seite, sodass du dich auf Strategie, Kundenentwicklung und Performance konzentrieren kannst. Technisches Verständnis: Du bist mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren CRM-Plattformen vertraut und verstehst die grundlegenden Zusammenhänge hinter erfolgreichen Set-ups. Analytisches Denken: Du kannst E-Commerce-KPIs interpretieren, Potenziale erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten. Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst unternehmerisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse. Eigenes Kundenportfolio: Du erhältst echte Entscheidungsfreiheit und gestaltest die Entwicklung deiner Accounts aktiv mit. Spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam: Copywriting, Design und technische Implementierung werden durch erfahrene Kollegen unterstützt. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite mit Experten aus E-Commerce, CRM und Retention-Marketing zusammen und entwickle deine strategischen Fähigkeiten weiter. Flache Hierarchien: Direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Fitnessstudio-Zuschuss: Wir unterstützen deinen sportlichen Ausgleich. Monatlicher Sachbezug: Nach deiner Probezeit erhältst du eine Sachbezugskarte mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben. Attraktive Vergütung: Möglichkeit auf Unternehmensanteile (ESOP) nach zwijähriger Firmenzugehörigkeit Firmenwagen: Je nach Position und individueller Vereinbarung besteht die Möglichkeit auf einen Firmenwagen. Unsere Kultur – Ownership statt Dienst nach Vorschrift Wir glauben an datenbasierte Entscheidungen, unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden. Bei uns zählt nicht, wer am lautesten spricht, sondern wer Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse liefert. Wir suchen Menschen, die Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen, Lösungen entwickeln und nicht darauf warten, dass ihnen jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Menschen, die ihre Kunden verstehen, ihre Zahlen kennen und den Anspruch haben, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag. So arbeiten wir dich ein Woche 1: Du lernst unsere Abläufe, unser Studio und den Setup-Standard kennen und baust deinen eigenen KI-Agenten, falls du noch keinen hast (inkl. aller relevanten Schulungen). Woche 2: Du bist bei Kickoff-Calls und Setups unseres Technik-Teams dabei. Ab Woche 3: Du führst deinen ersten eigenen Kickoff, und hast einen Mentor an deiner Seite, der dich dabei unterstützt. Nach rund 4 Wochen: Du machst Calls, Setup und Support eigenständig und übernimmst nach und nach immer mehr Eigenverantwortung. Qualifikation Du magst Technik und Menschen gleichermaßen und hast ggf. selbst mit KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Codex oder eigenen Agenten gearbeitet. Du telefonierst gern und erklärst Technik so, dass dich ein Schreinermeister und ein Geschäftsführer gleichermaßen verstehen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und verantwortungsbewusst, gerade mit Kundendaten. Du willst Gas geben, dazulernen und persönlich wachsen. Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift (C2), denn unsere Kunden sind deutsche Unternehmer. Englisch hilft bei Dokumentation und Tools, ist aber keine Bedingung. Optional: Du wohnst im Umkreis von Düsseldorf oder München (unsere Standorte) Welcher Abschluss dahintersteht, ist uns egal. Unsere Abläufe sind dokumentiert und lernbar – du musst nicht alles von Anfang an können. Wer nicht zu uns passt: Jemand, der lieber nur am Code sitzt und Kundengespräche als Störung empfindet. Jemand, der Dienst nach Vorschrift sucht.   6. Produkt: Du sammelst Fehler und Kundenfeedback und gehst sie einmal pro Woche mit unserem Team durch, und wirkst aktiv an der Verbesserung unserer Produkte mit.

  7. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag.

So arbeiten wir dich ein

  1. Woche 1: Du lernst unsere Abläufe, unser Studio und den Setup-Standard kennen und baust deinen eigenen KI-Agenten, falls du noch keinen hast (inkl. aller relevanten Schulungen).

  2. Woche 2: Du bist bei Kickoff-Calls und Setups unseres Technik-Teams dabei.

  3. Ab Woche 3: Du führst deinen ersten eigenen Kickoff, und hast einen Mentor an deiner Seite, der dich dabei unterstützt.

  4. Nach rund 4 Wochen: Du machst Calls, Setup und Support eigenständig und übernimmst nach und nach immer mehr Eigenverantwortung.

Qualifikation

  • Du magst Technik und Menschen gleichermaßen und hast ggf. selbst mit KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Codex oder eigenen Agenten gearbeitet.

  • Du telefonierst gern und erklärst Technik so, dass dich ein Schreinermeister und ein Geschäftsführer gleichermaßen verstehen.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und verantwortungsbewusst, gerade mit Kundendaten.

  • Du willst Gas geben, dazulernen und persönlich wachsen.

  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift (C2), denn unsere Kunden sind deutsche Unternehmer. Englisch hilft bei Dokumentation und Tools, ist aber keine Bedingung.

  • Optional: Du wohnst im Umkreis von Düsseldorf oder München (unsere Standorte)

  • Welcher Abschluss dahintersteht, ist uns egal. Unsere Abläufe sind dokumentiert und lernbar – du musst nicht alles von Anfang an können.

Wer nicht zu uns passt:

  • Jemand, der Dienst nach Vorschrift sucht. Wir erwarten keine Dauerbereitschaft und kein Wochenende am Laptop, aber dass du Dinge zu Ende denkst und einen eigenen Anspruch an die Exzellenz deiner Arbeit hast ⭐

B. das Deutschlandticket), sowie Zugang zu einem Fahrrad-Leasing-Programm. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Zusammenarbeit mit Degura zur Absicherung deiner finanziellen Zukunft. title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p><strong>About the Product team&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.</p> <p>We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day.&nbsp;</p> <p>This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants &amp; consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.</p> </li> <li> <p>Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Strong Craft &amp; Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.</p> </li> <li> <p>Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ownership &amp; Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.</p> </li> <li> <p>Growth &amp; Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.</p> </li> <li> <p>Tools &amp; Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).</p> </li> <li> <p>5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Base Pay Grade: L</p> <p>Equity Grade: UK 5</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.</p> <p>GBR base pay range per year<strong>: £<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_0" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">101,000</span>&nbsp;-&nbsp;<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_1" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">149,000</span></strong></p> <p>Location: Remote UK</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. title: Staff System Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.</p> <p>You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.</p> <p>This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.</p> <p>Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to build the tests, tools and release gates that help Graphcore deliver trusted system software? Apply now to join the team.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You’ll help the team detect and manage hardware faults arising during manufacturing and product use.</p> <p>You’ll analyse PCB designs for testability and manufacturing risks, then develop boundary scan and embedded functional tests. You will guide product performance through launch, production ramp and sustained high volume manufacturing.</p> <p data-start="483" data-end="663">Your work will influence chip manufacturing, test, PCBA and system level production. title: Director, Post-Silicon Validation
description: <p>Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and datacentre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, we are working to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure that its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. As the Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for leading the Bristol team, enabling pre-production software to run reliably on new silicon quickly and efficiently, before showing that the silicon meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and functionality, ready for production deployment.</p> <p>Reporting to the Senior Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol, delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol: </strong>The Post Silicon Validation team is relatively new, with a strong remit and growing quickly to help Graphcore bring up new silicon quickly and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Play a significant role in the definition, planning and execution of chip bringup activities: </strong>Develop and refine the overall post-silicon validation approach for our AI SoCs, ensuring reliable and timely delivery of validated silicon, architectural correctness, feature robustness, and at-scale system reliability.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-domain debug and issue resolution: </strong>Lead investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, and platform interactions. Ensure that fixes are effective and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>Promote collaboration and shared understanding: </strong>Work closely with design, software, and validation teams to align on quality objectives and debug priorities. Use data-driven insights and clear communication to maintain focus and alignment across teams.</li> <li><strong>Advance automation and scalable validation: </strong>Encourage the use of emulation, prototyping, and large-scale validation infrastructure to improve coverage and reduce time to debug.</li> <li><strong>Support continuous improvement: </strong>Foster a culture that values learning, transparency, and improvement in validation methods, automation, and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Engage with leadership and partners: </strong>Provide clear and concise updates on validation progress, risks, and quality indicators to executive teams and key partners. Contribute to product readiness assessments and roadmap decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building and running high performing teams</li> <li>A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries</li> <li>A collaborative leader who builds trust and alignment across diverse teams</li> <li>Skilled in technical problem solving and debugging complex post-silicon issues</li> <li>A clear communicator who can simplify complexity and support sound decision-making in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Committed to developing people and promoting an inclusive, high-performing team culture</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering or equivalent; Master’s preferred</li> <li>20+ years in silicon, system, or platform validation, including 10+ years in technical leadership</li> <li>Proven experience leading post-silicon validation and bring-up for complex SoCs (AI, GPU, or CPU)</li> <li>Strong understanding of SoC architecture, coherency protocols, power management, and interconnects</li> <li>Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks</li> <li>Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage</li> </ul> <p>Benefits</p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension, life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
