raw.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

raw.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
raw.description:

Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
description: Over ons Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid. Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd. We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen. Het Operations Team Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
description: Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results? HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working. You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year. About the role As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making. What you will do Your responsibilities will include: Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and . act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights; Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs. Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases. Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances. Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances. Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact. Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes. Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments. Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives.  Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L.  Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting. Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure. Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation. Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled. E stablish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners. Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board. Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency. You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers. This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions.  You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation.  You will also have: A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage. Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role. Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations. A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury. Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured. Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses. Experience working with consolidation tools. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment. Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage. Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What do we offer At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself. You can expect: a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making; a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year; an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary;  full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave;  a pension scheme;  a commuting allowance;  a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Be part of it.</h2> <p>Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software &amp; Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening &amp; Protection Solutions: Where design &amp; engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening &amp; Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​<br><br>​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:</p> <ul> <li>It all starts with your application and a video interview.</li> <li>Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.</li> <li>Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.</li> <li>Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.</li> <li>And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.</li> </ul> <p>​Exciting, right? Let's get started!</p> <p><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization.
